1 × DGX Spark, GB10 (128 GB unified memory); BF16

StartLux Labs' released StartLux-Decision-v1.1-2B-Instant (at f1e6cd1), a fine-tune of Qwen3.5-2B that reads the prompt bidirectionally and also reads images. It ran on our hardware (one DGX Spark), one request at a time, through the server of its package (startlux-decide serve --launch-vllm, StartLux-Decision at a99977d) on vLLM 0.31.0, with vision on: the card's scores were measured on vLLM 0.19.1, which has no build for the DGX Spark's processor (aarch64). Its weights are licensed for non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 4.0); we use them non-commercially, for evaluation. Its card lists English only.

Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept.
